BiblicalUsage: Zeah is sweat, and it appears at the very beginning of the curse: in the sweat of thy face shalt thou eat bread. Work was given before the fall, but after it the same work comes with sweat, thorns, and dust.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that sweat is honest work made hard by sin, and the same brow that sweats in the field will one day rest in a garden without thorns.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
